english.notes:
(i) This offence relates to a breach of SOPO, interim SOPO or foreign travel orders made under sections 103A to 103k of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
(ii) For breaches of SOPO, interim SOPO or foreign travel order prior to 29th November 2022, see offence H11483.
